nu_subtitle: CuerdOS is a free, stable and powerful operating system based on Void Linux. If you are coming from Windows or macOS, you will find everything you need to get started on the right foot. You do not need to know anything about programming or the terminal to enjoy it to the fullest.
nu_fs_update_d: The first thing to do is update CuerdOS. Open the update tool in the Tools tab to get the latest security patches and improvements.
nu_fs_store_d: Discover thousands of free programs: browsers, text editors, players and much more. All from one place, no external downloads.
nu_fs_printer_d: Go to System Settings then Printers. Most printers are detected automatically when connected.
nu_fs_datetime_d: In System Settings you can set the time zone, date format and interface language.
nu_cu_wallpaper_d: Right-click on the desktop and choose Change wallpaper. Use your own photos or the included backgrounds.
nu_cu_theme_d: In Settings then Appearance you can change colors, icons and window style to personalize everything.
nu_cu_fonts_d: If text looks small go to Settings then Accessibility and increase the font size until comfortable.
nu_cu_panel_d: Right-click on the panel to add, remove and reorder shortcuts. Set it up however you like.
nu_app_browser_d: Vivaldi comes pre-installed in CuerdOS. It is a powerful and customizable browser with many advanced features.
nu_app_office_d: LibreOffice is included in CuerdOS. Compatible with .docx, .xlsx and .pptx — free, powerful, and open source.
nu_app_media_d: Haruna and Celluloid are both included in CuerdOS. They play music and video with clean, modern interfaces.
nu_app_photos_d: gThumb is the simple image viewer and editor included in CuerdOS. Easily crop, rotate and adjust your photos.
nu_app_email_d: Thunderbird is a full-featured free email client. You can also use webmail from the browser.
nu_app_files_d: The included file manager lets you browse, copy and organize documents easily, just like Windows.
nu_sa_update_d: Installing updates is the most important thing to keep your system secure. Do it at least once a week.
nu_sa_backup_d: Copy important documents to an external drive or cloud. Hardware can fail unexpectedly.
nu_sa_root: Do not use the root account
nu_sa_root_d: For daily tasks always use your normal account. Root is only for system configuration.
nu_sa_passwords_d: Use different passwords for each service. KeePassXC is a great free password manager.
nu_h_wiki_d: Official project guides, tutorials and documentation
nu_h_web_d: Official page with news, downloads and more about CuerdOS
nu_h_changelog_d: Check the latest news and changes for each release
nu_h_debian_d: The most complete GNU/Linux knowledge base
nu_h_forum_d: Ask, share and learn with other CuerdOS users
